subject: Post-call: budget & procurement thresholds (Acme Payments)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acmepayments.com>, Joe Liao <joe.liao@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: budget & procurement thresholds (Acme Payments)

Hi Samira / Joe —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align on budget and procurement requirements before sending a formal quote.

Recap (from our call):
- Estimated initial usage: ~10-15M tokens/month (chat + generation).
- Primary goal: replace current NLU pipeline and add assistant features; latency and throughput are important.
- Procurement: Samira flagged internal procurement thresholds (PO/approval limits).

Budget / unit economics (high-level ranges for validation):
- Pilot band (low): $3k-$10k / month -> ~1-5M tokens / month (~$20-$30 per 1M tokens).
- Growth band (mid): $10k-$50k / month -> ~5-25M tokens / month (target $/1M = $15-$22).
- Enterprise band (high): $50k+ / month -> 25M+ tokens (committed pricing / reserved capacity).

Ask for you (Samira):
1) Can you confirm the expected monthly token band (best guess for first 3 months vs steady-state)?
2) What procurement thresholds should we plan for (i.e., any PO minimums, VP sign-off thresholds, required vendor docs)?
3) Any billing constraints (Net30 invoice, centralized billing, PO on file)?

Next steps from our side: I’ll draft a simple quote and MAP based on the band you confirm and include line items for committed vs pay-as-you-go pricing. Attaching our pricing cheatsheet + a draft mutual-action-plan for your review.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acmepayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Joe Liao <joe.liao@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmepayments.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: budget & procurement thresholds (Acme Payments)

Thanks Marissa — quick answers below.

Expected volumes: 10-15M tokens/month for the first 3 months while we ramp; steady-state 12-20M/month.
Target budget: roughly $12k-$18k/month during pilot.

Procurement thresholds:
- Anything over $25k total value requires VP approval + legal review.
- Under $25k we can typically sign a standard SOW via procurement within our normal cadence.
- We do need vendor W9 and SOC 2 Type II evidence before vendor onboarding.

Billing: standard Net30. We prefer one main invoice to our AP system; cc procurement on any quotes.

Can you provide per-1M token line items and any committed discount tiers? Also please cc procurement (included) on the quote.

Samira Khan
Head of AI, Acme Payments
samira.khan@acmepayments.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call: budget & procurement thresholds (Acme Payments)

Looping in some suggested pricing tiers so Marissa can include in the formal quote. Note: these are draft and we can flex on committed terms.

Suggested pricing (hosted API, per 1M tokens):
- Pay-as-you-go: $25 / 1M tokens
- Committed ladder (monthly avg):
  - 5-10M: $22 / 1M
  - 10-25M: $18 / 1M
  - 25M+: $15 / 1M (enterprise/reserved capacity recommended)

Suggested commercial structure:
- 3-month pilot at estimated 12M tokens/month -> estimated $15k/month (using $18/1M for ramp pricing).
- After pilot: offer 12-month committed contract with step-down pricing (15-20% effective discount depending on commit).
- If they need predictable latency and SLAs, propose Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) + fixed monthly fee (we'll price separately).

I’ve attached a quick quote draft for Marissa to iterate on. If procurement needs PO thresholds, we can structure the initial pilot <= $25k to avoid VP approval and expedite legal.

-Rishi
Director, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
From: Procurement <procurement@acmepayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@acmepayments.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: budget & procurement thresholds (Acme Payments)

Hi Marissa —

Procurement checklist / timeline:
- We can approve purchases up to $25k on our standard SOW template without VP sign-off. Anything > $25k will need VP approval and legal turnaround (typically adds 2-3 weeks).
- Required vendor docs: W9, SOC 2 Type II report, company registration, primary contact for invoicing.
- Invoice terms: Net30; PO required for payment.

Please send a final quote and draft SOW by EOD Friday so we can start review. We also need to know if Redwood supports centralized billing (single invoice for multi-department usage) - we prefer one invoice per month to our AP system.

Regards,
Acme Procurement Team
procurement@acmepayments.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acmepayments.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: budget & procurement thresholds (Acme Payments)

Thanks everyone — appreciate the clarity.

Quick summary & next steps:
- Confirmed expected pilot usage: 10-15M tokens/month (we'll price conservatively at 12M).
- Proposed pilot commercial: 3 months at $15,000 / month (estimated 12M tokens @ $18 / 1M). This keeps total pilot <= $50k but we can split into monthly invoices (Net30) to fit your PO cadence.
- If you want to keep procurement path under $25k to avoid VP sign-off, we can do a 1-month starter at $12,000 then convert to a 2-month renewal while legal reviews the full SOW. Let me know which path you prefer.

Attachments: final quote draft (quote-draft-acme.pdf), updated MAP (mutual-action-plan.xlsx). I also uploaded SOC 2 evidence + W9 to the shared drive link: https://drive.redwood.company/shared/acme-payments/proposal

Can we aim to have procurement confirm preferred PO path by EOD Monday so we can get the pilot started next week?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
